diffSummary: Added FilterBar component with search, status, itemType, and role filters. Updated document-list.tsx, items-list.tsx, parties-list.tsx, boms-list.tsx, payments-list.tsx to use FilterBar and pass filters to useCollection. Extended API query schemas and services for items (itemType), parties (role), boms (q + pagination), payments (q). Added i18n keys for all filter labels in French, English, and Arabic.
manualNotes: The implementation follows the existing patterns in the codebase. The FilterBar component is reusable across all list screens. The API query schemas are strict and validate filter parameters. The i18n keys are added for all three supported locales. The components use lazy state initialization from searchParams to avoid ESLint warnings about setState in useEffect.
